errors.evidence: The figure does not have a label for the vertical axis. The description hallucinates the label “数量” (quantity).
The vertical axis does not have any units specified. The description states the unit is '句子' (sentences), which is an inference from the caption but not explicitly present on the axis itself.
The phrase '刻度含量为线性' is awkward and non-standard. A clearer way to phrase this would be '刻度是线性的' (the scale is linear).
